name: Perplexity Comet Enterprise
desc: The Comet AI browser for organizations, deployable over MDM with agent controls.
desc_zh: 面向组织的 Comet AI 浏览器，可经 MDM 静默部署并按动作管控智能体。
solves: A personal AI browser on a work machine is an unmanaged risk; this gives administrators deployment, policies and audit over the same browser.
solves_zh: 办公电脑上装个人 AI 浏览器是不可控风险；它让管理员对同一个浏览器拥有部署、策略与审计能力。
best_for: You are rolling an AI browser to two thousand laptops and need to decide which actions the agent may take.
best_for_zh: 要把 AI 浏览器铺到两千台笔记本，还得决定智能体可以做哪些动作时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — perplexity.ai changelog directory; channel C CIO Dive coverage）。 Missing from the ledger; the ledger has Perplexity Comet (2025-07-09) but not the enterprise edition. Comet Enterprise is a separate deployment of the same browser rather than a version of it, with MDM deployment, browser policies and per-action agent controls, and security controls developed with CrowdStrike. The changelog entry is dated 03/12/26 in the page body. perplexity.ai returns 403 to curl, so the page was read through the page reader. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：账本里现有的记录叫「Perplexity Comet」，企业版的名字与它保持一致。 首次公开日期来源：https://www.perplexity.ai/changelog/what-we-shipped---march-13-2026 官网未直接确认（403）。
